params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo=Join-Path $HOME 'local-ai-workspaces\mhw-mods'
$wt=Join-Path $HOME 'HeavenBridge\verify-current-main-uia'
git -C $repo fetch origin main --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'fetch main failed'}
$sha=(git -C $repo rev-parse origin/main).Trim()
Write-Output ('REMOTE_MAIN_SHA='+$sha)
if(Test-Path $wt){ git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null | Out-Null }
git -C $repo worktree prune
git -C $repo worktree add --detach $wt $sha
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'worktree add failed'}
try {
  $py=(Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
  & $py -m py_compile (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\worker.py') (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\test_worker.py') (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py')
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'py_compile failed'}
  & $py (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\test_worker.py')
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'primary tests failed'}
  & $py (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\tests\test_worker.py')
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'compatibility tests failed'}
  foreach($p in @('bootstrap.ps1','manage.ps1','uia.ps1','install-github-runner.ps1')){
    $tokens=$null;$errors=$null
    [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Join-Path $wt ('heaven-bridge\'+$p)),[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors)
    if($errors.Count -gt 0){$errors|Format-List|Out-String|Write-Error;throw ('PowerShell parse failed: '+$p)}
  }
  $plugin=Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\plugin\plugin.json')|ConvertFrom-Json
  $codex=Get-Content -Raw (Join-Path $wt 'heaven-bridge\plugin\.codex-plugin\plugin.json')|ConvertFrom-Json
  if($plugin.version -ne $codex.version){throw 'plugin manifest version mismatch'}

  $formPath=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'heaven-uia-smoke-form.ps1'
  @'
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
$form=New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Form
$form.Text='Heaven UIA Smoke'
$form.Width=420
$form.Height=180
$input=New-Object System.Windows.Forms.TextBox
$input.Name='HeavenBridgeInput'
$input.AccessibleName='Smoke Input'
$input.Left=20;$input.Top=20;$input.Width=340
$button=New-Object System.Windows.Forms.Button
$button.Name='HeavenBridgeButton'
$button.AccessibleName='Close Smoke'
$button.Text='Close Smoke'
$button.Left=20;$button.Top=65;$button.Width=120
$button.Add_Click({$form.Close()})
$form.Controls.Add($input)
$form.Controls.Add($button)
[System.Windows.Forms.Application]::Run($form)
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $formPath -Encoding UTF8

  $smokePy=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'heaven-uia-smoke.py'
  @'
import importlib.util, json, os, time
from pathlib import Path
wt=Path(os.environ["VERIFY_WT"])
os.environ["HEAVEN_BRIDGE_REPO"]=str(wt)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("hb_smoke", wt/"heaven-bridge"/"worker.py")
hb=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(hb)
pid=int(os.environ["SMOKE_PID"])
tree=hb.desktop_uia({"pid":pid,"first_match":True,"max_nodes":120,"max_depth":6},"uia_tree")
assert tree["count"] > 0, tree
found=hb.desktop_uia({"pid":pid,"first_match":True,"selector":{"name":"Smoke Input"}},"uia_find")
assert found["count"] >= 1, found
set_result=hb.desktop_uia({"pid":pid,"first_match":True,"selector":{"name":"Smoke Input"},"value":"semantic-smoke"},"uia_set_value")
assert set_result["set_value"] and set_result["characters"] == len("semantic-smoke"), set_result
button=hb.desktop_uia({"pid":pid,"first_match":True,"selector":{"name":"Close Smoke","control_type":"Button"}},"uia_find")
assert button["count"] >= 1, button
invoked=hb.desktop_uia({"pid":pid,"first_match":True,"selector":{"name":"Close Smoke","control_type":"Button"}},"uia_invoke")
assert invoked["invoked"], invoked
print("UIA_TREE_COUNT="+str(tree["count"]))
print("UIA_FIND_SET_INVOKE_OK")
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $smokePy -Encoding UTF8

  $uiProc=Start-Process powershell.exe -PassThru -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-Sta','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$formPath)
  try {
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 900
    $env:VERIFY_WT=$wt
    $env:SMOKE_PID=[string]$uiProc.Id
    & $py $smokePy
    if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'UIA live smoke failed'}
  } finally {
    try { if(-not $uiProc.HasExited){Stop-Process -Id $uiProc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue} } catch {}
    Remove-Item $formPath,$smokePy -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  }
  Write-Output ('PLUGIN_VERSION='+$plugin.version)
  Write-Output 'BRIDGE_MAIN_GATE_OK'
} finally {
  git -C $repo worktree remove --force $wt 2>$null | Out-Null
  git -C $repo worktree prune
}
